name: Family Rejection
overview: Scripture acknowledges the painful reality of family rejection but assures believers of God's faithful care and provision. When earthly parents forsake their children, the Lord Himself gathers and upholds them, demonstrating a compassion that surpasses human limitations. Trusting fully in the Lord rather than our own understanding is essential, as He hears the cries of the righteous and delivers them from their troubles. Moreover, God's covenant blessings extend to all families, promising that through faith in Him, believers find a lasting spiritual family and unshakable support.
